driver_design_review: GO: remove extra truth interpolation and replace the uncalibrated z=0 Gaussian-logdensity/fully deterministic velocity closure with an independently trained development z=0 covariance. Reuse existing PM artifacts and posterior driver; no new simulation or generic framework.
goal: CF4-informed present density/velocity posterior, then consistent IC/forward validation and LG-only 0.3 cMpc/h zoom in 1-2 cMpc/h surroundings. This N32 diagnostic/prototype does not attain those resolutions.
reference: https://arxiv.org/abs/1312.1354 distinguishes density and log-density power spectra; this implementation is a development empirical joint-prior prototype, not a reproduction of that paper.

data.contract: Native density and mass-weighted velocity, no post-hoc truth interpolation or smoothing. Training split is frozen before fitting; evaluation truths do not set covariance. All are previously used development simulations, NOT pristine validation. No observed counts/vobs enter fits.

model.coordinate_contract: Native PM N64 node-pair block averages have centroid3, spacing12. Use this origin for source positions and velocity reads; keep survey count-bin centres6 and existing TSC deposition/selection. No resampling of truth arrays.
model.density: g=log(rho)-mean(log(rho)); train its Fourier covariance from four native PM fields; rho=exp(g)/mean(exp(g))
model.velocity: Train E[v(k)|g(k)] and longitudinal/transverse residual covariance. Three additional Gaussian white fields supply conditional velocity scatter, including vorticity and finite-volume bulk variance.
model.assumptions: Gaussian joint log-density/velocity, isotropy, fixed finite-ensemble covariance. Non-Gaussian density-shape and covariance uncertainty remain approximations; no claim of exact dynamics.
model.LCDM_IC_power: UNCHANGED. This estimates statistics of the nonlinear, deposited z=0 observable, not a fitted correction A(k) to an IC or to a reconstructed map.
model.mock_observation_model: Same coarse six-population normalized bias/RSD/FoG/selection and fixed CF4 geometry as Z5; independent tracer/selection systematics are not tested.

sampler.initialization: zero candidate plus 0.5 standardized jitter in every free coordinate; no truth initializer or extra MAP fit

required: native-coordinate read/deposit consistency and PSD joint covariance
same-data baseline vs repaired physical posterior
repeat repaired model on second non-training truth
bias intervals, density coverage/recovery and heldout prediction
assessment.decision: No-go for promotion if mechanics fail or physical mismatch remains. Two development truths and fitted covariance cannot certify calibration even on apparent success. Freeze criteria and stop after this bundle.

completion: Calibration/test Slurm job, afterany GPU array (fail early unless calibration passes), then afterany CPU aggregation. No repeated filesystem tests, process scans, or next-bundle auto-launch.
